items.description: Leading the core infrastructure team for Gemini API. Optimized distributed inference latency by 40% using custom gRPC extensions and advanced caching strategies. Mentoring senior engineers and defining architectural roadmaps for AI-at-scale.
Architected the new 'Spotify for Artists' analytics pipeline capable of processing 50TB of daily event data. Migrated legacy Java monoliths to Go microservices, reducing cloud costs by 25%.
Worked as a top 3% freelancer with Fortune 500 clients. Designed a real-time bidding system for a major AdTech firm using Rust and Kafka, achieving sub-millisecond latency requirements.
Managed Kubernetes clusters serving 2M+ daily active users. Implemented GitOps workflows with ArgoCD and Helm, improving deployment frequency from weekly to daily.
Developed the product recommendation engine using Python and Spark. Optimized PostgreSQL queries for the Black Friday sale event, handling 50k requests per second.
Built internal developer tools and CI/CD pipelines. Maintained high-availability Redis clusters for session management across the Android app store.
Completed 40+ projects ranging from React dashboards to Node.js REST APIs. Specialized in building MVPs for early-stage startups in FinTech and HealthTech sectors.
Automated network configuration backups and switch provisioning using Python scripts and Ansible. Reduced manual configuration errors by 90%.
Researched distributed consensus algorithms (Paxos/Raft). Implemented a prototype distributed key-value store for academic benchmarking.
Started career building custom WordPress themes and PHP plugins for local businesses. Learned the fundamentals of web hosting, DNS, and SEO.
